content_sections.heading: NARIP Senior Research Fellow Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NARIP Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: NARIP Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NARIP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Research Fellow (Chemistry) post at NARIP is scheduled for 17 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criterion for the Senior Research Fellow (Chemistry) post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Senior Research Fellow (Chemistry) position, candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, or Analytical Chemistry from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (Chemistry) post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow (Chemistry) position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 42,000/- along with 10% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow (Chemistry) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Senior Research Fellow (Chemistry) position at the National Ayurveda Research Institute for Panchakarma (NARIP).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the NARIP Senior Research Fellow (Chemistry) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview for the eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the National Ayurveda Research Institute for Panchakarma (NARIP) office located in Cheruthuruthy, Kerala (PIN: 679531).

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Senior Research Fellow (Chemistry) position at NARIP is a contractual job.
